description:
Mandatory-field, type/format, and controlled-vocabulary checks derived from the cardinality table of the RDA DMP Common Standard v1.2 (https://github.com/RDA-DMP-Common/RDA-DMP-Common-Standard). This is the single base standard (extends: false); every other rules file extends it. '_allowed_values' are the standard's strict Allowed Values (a violation is a failure); '_suggested_values' are its Suggested Values (a mismatch is only a warning). '_type' says what each value is; list-ness is never a type, it is expressed by '_cardinality' alone.
The 'optional parent, mandatory children if present' pattern (e.g. affiliation) is expressed by giving the parent cardinality 0..n while its child fields get '1': the children are only evaluated for instances that actually exist. RDA DCS entities our DMPs do not populate yet (cost, project, related_identifier, metadata, technical_resource, security_and_privacy) are declared here on purpose — an absent optional field is reported 'missing', never a failure, which is exactly how we see which parts of the standard our data does not reach yet.
Fields are ordered depth-first, following the JSON structure itself: dmp's own fields first (alphabetically), and as soon as a field is a nested object its children are listed immediately below it (also alphabetically) before moving on to dmp's next sibling. This mirrors reading the JSON top to bottom rather than the standard's flat alphabetical index, which makes gaps against the real DMP structure easier to spot.
